messages:
Zoe: Kicked off a tiny 0.5% canary for rwd-nlg v3.3-int4-lite. Latency/cost look great but there's a concentrated QA/api-doc hit. posting quick smoke.

Marta: paste the slice deltas pls.

Zoe: short table from 1.6k samples: 
```
slice | base_RL | v3.3_RL | delta
qa | 0.70 | 0.65 | -7.1%
api-doc | 0.72 | 0.68 | -5.6%
short | 0.81 | 0.80 | -1.2%
```

Lin: yikes on QA. is it hallucination, truncation, or tokenization?

Zoe: mostly wrong spans and entity swaps (hallucination up ~14/1k). tokenizer-preserving tests show minor diffs so likely quant precision. used per-channel int4 with outlier-clamp. config: `quant: pchan_int4, clamp: top0.2%, seed: 777`.

Raj: rollout gate proposal: hold at 0.5% until either QA delta > -3% OR human review passes top-200 failures. auto-fallback rules should be multi-signal and debounced.

Marta: agree. propose auto-fallback: min_samples_per_slice=2000, eval_window=30m, stable_windows_required=2. triggers: rouge_l_drop_pct <= -2.5, hallucination_inc_per1k >= 3, user_reject_inc_pct >= 1.5. require 2 triggers within window to flip.

Lin: add composite safety score where hallucination weighted x3. prevents noisy RL-only flips. also require sample floor per-slice.

Zoe: rough YAML we can feed to gate engine: `auto_fallback: {min_samples_per_slice:2000, window:30m, stable_windows:2, triggers:[{metric:rouge_l_delta_pct,thresh:-2.5},{metric:halluc_per1k_abs,thresh:3},{metric:user_reject_delta_pct,thresh:1.5}],composite_weights:{rouge:0.2,halluc:0.6,user_reject:0.2},required_triggers:2}`

gate-bot: Canary report (v3.3-int4-lite) — traffic=0.5% for 50m, samples=1600, p50 latency -11%, p95 -17%, token-cost -30%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: action items: Zoe -> run targeted 12k QA sweep and post top-200 for human triage; Lin -> implement composite scoring and add sample-floor check; Raj -> reproduce quant locally with seed=777 and run hallucination detection. Hold scale until human pass or composite <0.25.

Zoe: will post eval link when ready. keeping this thread canonical for the canary. :lock:
